why_next: The critical fork question is answered: PMI null bias is intrinsic to plug-in estimation across varying-size strata with Laplace smoothing, NOT caused by deterministic/stochastic mixing. SPA redesign pathway closed. The 4 tested estimators (weighted PMI, equal-weight PMI, median PMI, KNN CMI k=5) all share plug-in/KNN construction. Truly orthogonal frameworks (KSG uses kNN distance-based estimation without stratum partitioning; Bayesian uses posteriors; likelihood-ratio compares nested models) remain untested and are the only remaining unexplored estimation pathway on this SPA class.

established: SPA redesign to 0% deterministic strata does NOT eliminate PMI null bias. Bias reproducible within 5.7e-05 bits of parent (weighted null_mean 0.407057 vs 0.407). Intrinsic to plug-in estimation. (EXP-PHYSICS-35470449605 result.json:null_control_comparison_to_parent, audit V2)

Null bias is monotonically decreasing in stratum size: +0.736 at size 5-9, +0.562 at 10-19, +0.369 at 20-49. Pattern identical to parent. (EXP-PHYSICS-35470449605 result.json:stratum_size_bias_decomposition, audit V6)
Equal-weight/median worsen bias (0.704/0.686 vs 0.407) by up-weighting small strata. KNN negative bias (-0.262) from Laplace + extra dimension. (EXP-PHYSICS-35470449605 result.json:screening_n5000)
Positive control validates all 4 pipelines: K3 1.81-1.87 (stratum), 1.19 (KNN), p=0.001. C1 failures not execution defects. (EXP-PHYSICS-35470449605 controls.C3-POSITIVE-CONTROL)
K2 PMI=0.933 and K3 PMI=1.221 are reproducible point estimates (replicate parent exactly). (EXP-PHYSICS-35470449605 result.json:metrics.k2_pmi_weighted, k3_pmi_weighted)
SPA has beyond-Markov structure by construction (choose_next depends on 2-step history). A valid estimator SHOULD detect K3>K2. (EXP-PHYSICS-35470449605 run_experiment.py:CANDIDATES/choose_next)

Empirical determinism persists despite 0% design-level: 31.5% K2 and 10.8% K3 strata deterministic from hash collisions. (EXP-PHYSICS-35470449605 result.json:determinism_k2_n5000, determinism_k3_n5000)

Per-stratum plug-in PMI null bias is monotonically increasing in small strata: +0.736 at 5-9 vs +0.369 at 20-49. Bias is Laplace small-sample artifact, not environment mixing. (EXP-PHYSICS-35470449605 stratum_size_bias_decomposition)

Run all 7 estimators (4 parent + 3 orthogonal) at N=5000 with identical shuffled-action null (N_SHUFFLE=500, |mean| < 0.1 threshold).
